description.narrative: (Tanzania): ...With FY 2022 funds, USAID will ensure the transparent delivery of public health, educational, and other government services that are responsive to local government authorities. Public Sector Systems Strengthening Plus (PS3+) will focus on improved effectiveness of local government systems and structures to respond to citizens' needs for quality services, while contributing to overall health and education outcomes. The main components are citizen engagement, governance and social accountability, resource mobilization, and public financial management. USAID will extend planning and oversight of financial systems to communities and empower citizens to participate actively in school and health facilities' governing committees, thereby increasing their oversight and involvement in budget planning and execution. ..This is a multi-sectoral activity, with funding and outcomes related to systems strengthening across different technical sectors. However, health is a major thrust of the activity and it supports three of the four result areas of USAID's HSS strategy. The activity focuses squarely on building local capacity and commitments through the subnational government and institutionalization of improved, decentralized public sector systems. .... .
